sample-1-1: The January 2024 storm took out our working waterfront in one tide cycle. Fish houses that stood for a hundred years, gone in a morning. If the state can help us rebuild higher and stronger instead of just rebuilding, that's the difference between islands with a future and islands without one.
sample-1-2: Our public works budget can't absorb a washout that takes three culverts at once, and that's now happening every other year. The infrastructure grants in this bill are the first proposal I've seen that matches the size of the problem towns like ours are facing.
sample-1-3: Nobody disputes the storms were bad. My concern is creating a permanent new state office with permanent staff for what should be a time-limited rebuilding effort. Fund the grants, skip the bureaucracy.
